name: Paired mandibles icon
description: UI slot icon for the paired mandibles, composing `ss.proj.boom` via `use`. Third of the weapon icons to be derived from its projectile instead of hand-drawn a second time — the original BootScene authored five weapon shapes twice, with independently tuned coordinates. Rim is `$chitin` — the jaw's own amber rather than the husk it is mostly drawn in, because the Lash already owns bone.

evolved.description: Gnashing Jaws. The rim goes gold the way every evolved slot does, and the bound pair becomes `ss.proj.gnash` — the awakened jaws the weapon actually throws, at their resting gape, teeth bloodied — composed rather than redrawn, so the slot and the field can never disagree about what the thing looks like. One bead of blood (`ss.fx.drip`, the same drop the field sheds off a wound) hangs between the hooks, falling: the slot says what the evolution adds, which is not more jaws but what is left behind when they let go. No pair of jaws and no spiral round it any more — the weapon no longer dances.
